info.name: Juniper Networks Juniper Advanced Threat Prevention (ATP) Cloud API

description.content:
Juniper Advanced Threat Prevention (ATP) Cloud API provides access to threat intelligence, malware analysis, and security event management. The API enables querying threat feeds, submitting files for analysis, retrieving detection verdicts, managing allow/block lists, and accessing threat intelligence data for integration with SRX Series firewalls and other security infrastructure.
